initial_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

A university student residence clearly needs nearby university/school services. Set to the 75th percentile (75.14), rounded to 75.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: gross surface area of at least 850 sqm, energy class A1 through C, mobility score of at least 71, and education score of at least 75. A 3.0 km haversine radius around the supplied coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892) constrains location. Results are ordered by distance from that point. The office property type and the 60-bed/funding-program details are not in the extracted requirements, so they are not filtered on.
